title: Hoelder bound for lower integrals of arbitrary [0,∞]-valued functions on a set
statement: Let X be a type with a measurable-space structure, μ a measure on X, B ⊆ X an arbitrary subset, g : X → [0, ∞] an arbitrary function (no measurability assumed), and p, q real numbers with 0 < q ≤ p. Then, with Mathlib's lower Lebesgue integral ∫⁻_B f dμ := ∫⁻ f d(μ.restrict B) and real powers in [0, ∞] (ENNReal.rpow), ∫⁻_B g^q dμ ≤ (∫⁻_B g^p dμ)^{q/p} · μ(B)^{1-q/p}.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (B : Set X) (g : X → ℝ≥0∞) (p q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ p → ∫⁻ x in B, g x ^ q ∂μ ≤ (∫⁻ x in B, g x ^ p ∂μ) ^ (q / p) * μ B ^ (1 - q / p)
